name: wobblehoard
description: WOBBLEHOARD — a 3D soft-body squishy collectible toy. Poke it, squash it, let go. Three.js + TypeScript + Vite, procedural WebAudio. `npm install && npm run dev`.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run probe
scripts.probe:browser: npm run probe:audio && npm run probe:render && npm run probe:shell
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build && python ../../pipeline/deploy_game.py --game-dir dist --slug wobblehoard --dry-run
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run build && python ../../pipeline/deploy_game.py --game-dir dist --slug wobblehoard
